_comment: The fourth section of /regulations: acts the software does not apply yet, each of which binds a product group it models, a feature on the roadmap, or the software itself. Hand-written and landing-owned, like applied-acts.json. An adopted act or a proposal links by `celex`; a draft has no CELEX number and links to its EUR-Lex page by `url`. Status of each checked on EUR-Lex on 2026-09-30: the two battery drafts are still drafts, COM(2025) 504 is still a proposal (listed as 'amendment proposed by' on both the Batteries Regulation and ESPR), and 2025/1943, 2016/650, 2023/1115 and 2024/2847 are in force. Tyres are in 2023/1115 Annex I (ex 4011), which is why it is here.

groups.title: Drafts and proposals that would change passports

acts.name: Battery carbon footprint method
acts.ref: Draft Commission Delegated Regulation under Regulation (EU) 2023/1542
acts.what: How an electric vehicle battery's carbon footprint is calculated. Battery passports carry that figure, and the software will not calculate one before this method is adopted.

acts.name: Carbon footprint declaration format
acts.ref: Draft Commission Implementing Regulation under Regulation (EU) 2023/1542
acts.what: The form a battery's carbon footprint declaration takes. It would apply alongside the calculation method.

acts.name: Digital product rules
acts.what: Not yet law. Where a product needs a digital passport, its EU declaration of conformity and its instructions would be provided in that passport. It would also amend the Batteries Regulation and ESPR.

groups.title: Needed for features on the roadmap

acts.name: Qualified certificates for seals
acts.what: The standards a qualified certificate for electronic seals is issued under. A company needs such a certificate before the node's seals can carry legal effect.

acts.name: Secure devices for seal keys
acts.what: The standards for the secure devices that hold the key behind a qualified seal. They matter for seals with legal effect and for keeping keys in hardware, both on the roadmap.

groups.title: Rules for products the software models

acts.name: Deforestation Regulation
acts.what: Before products such as new rubber tyres are placed on the EU market, a due diligence statement must be filed. Tyres are a product group the software models; it does not record that statement today.

acts.name: Cyber Resilience Act
acts.what: Security requirements for software and connected products placed on the EU market, applying in stages. It concerns the software itself, not what goes into a passport.
